resources.string: Welcome to the world of Qurio, where questions spark curiosity and prizes await the smartest. Ready to begin the challenge?
Each hero has their own unique style! Choose from unique characters and start your adventure in your own style.
Answer quickly, earn points, and share with your friends!\n Each trivia category is a new experience.
Unlock characters, earn badges, and climb the leaderboards. Qurio is merciless, but you can handle it.
